Diego / Mina — quick draft notes below that I'll drop into the consolidated reply. High-level: we do not persist raw PII in long-term storage for hosted customers who opt into telemetry minimization; transient KV cache and request logs are retained for up to 7 days by default and can be shortened. Subprocessor access: our hosting partners (GCloud US-east region) and monitoring vendor (Watchtower Ops) have access only to infrastructure-level logs; they do NOT have access to application-level PII except when a customer has explicitly enabled debug/trace mode and provided consent. KMS: customer-controlled keys (Bring-Your-Own-Key) are supported for Dedicated and Private; for hosted, we offer a customer key in a Redwood-managed HSM with strict split-role access (see attached kms_key_custody_matrix.pdf).

Notes to include: 
- Dataflow diagram: attached 'dataflow_diagram_v2.png' annotated with ingress, pre-processing, inference, transient cache, metrics flow, and retention points.
- Subprocessors with potential PII access: Watchtower Ops (monitoring) - infrastructure logs only; CDN provider (EdgeStream) - no application PII; storage snapshot provider (StorSync) - encrypted, access controlled and only used for backups in US regions.
- Cross-border: by default hosted inference remains in the elected region (US-east). We provide contract language to commit processing to US-only for covered datasets; this requires a residency addendum.

I'll flag items that likely require legal sign-off (residency addendum, BYOK for hosted customers, subcontractor access exceptions).

Adding technical clarifications for the SSQ rows:

1) Access controls: all access to PII is RBAC enforced, with least-privilege IAM roles and scoped service accounts. We rotate service account keys quarterly and require MFA for operator access.
2) Telemetry minimization: request bodies are redacted by default for PII-sensitive fields when customers opt into "PII-safe telemetry"; otherwise we retain sufficient tracing info to debug production issues.
3) KMS details: for Hosted customers using Redwood-managed HSM, we maintain split-role access: (a) key material stored in HSM; (b) control-plane metadata held separately; only an automated, auditable key wrapping service performs ephemeral unwraps during deployment. We provide customer attestations and can include an exporter for audit exports.
4) Logs & inference residency: inference occurs in the elected region; ephemeral logs are routed to the same region by default. Exported metrics (aggregates) can cross regions but contain no raw PII.

I'll annotate the SSQ spreadsheet with these answers and indicate 'requires residency addendum' where applicable.

Mina Haddad
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Alex — thanks for the patience. Attached is our consolidated SSQ response (we filled rows 7-22 in your spreadsheet), the annotated dataflow diagram, and the KMS custody matrix. Summary highlights: 

- PII persistence: For hosted customers who opt into "PII-safe telemetry", raw PII is not persisted beyond the request lifetime; default transient retention is 7 days unless you request a shorter retention period (we can contractually cap to 0 days for specific endpoints).
- Subprocessors: Watchtower Ops (monitoring) and EdgeStream (CDN) are subprocessors used for infrastructure-level telemetry; neither has application-level raw PII access under normal operations. StorSync may hold encrypted backups; access is strictly controlled and audited. Full subprocessor roster is listed in the spreadsheet with scope.
- KMS custody: Dedicated/Private: BYOK supported; customer retains CMK control. Hosted: Redwood-managed HSM with split-role controls and auditable unwraps. We can provide KMS attestation artifacts on request and offer to include a clause in the DPA to require HSM attestation quarterly.
- Cross-border processing: Inference and ephemeral logs remain in the elected region (US-east) by default. Aggregated telemetry may move for analytics but contains no raw PII. If you require a US-only processing guarantee in contract, we can provide a residency addendum and are prepared to escalate to Legal for the amendment.
